chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Isma'il ibn 'Ammar, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who gives a female slave as a gift to his daughter's husband, and he has already had intercourse with her. Will his daughter's husband have intercourse with her? He said, 'There is no harm in that.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a father gifts a female slave to his daughter's husband after consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the legal status of a female slave gifted by her owner to her husband after consummation, ruling that the husband’s right to intercourse remains valid without impediment. This ruling underscores the principle that the act of consummation establishes the marital bond's physical permissibility, regardless of subsequent changes in ownership, reflecting the flexibility of Shia jurisprudence in family law. The narration highlights the Imam's role in resolving specific practical scenarios faced by the community, ensuring clarity in the rights of spouses regarding property and intimacy.
